phi_nhan_tam.wants: The halls of Tê Nhạn Quán roofed again before he dies, and the geese left in them undisturbed.
phi_nhan_tam.secret: He feeds the geese in the ruin three sacks of terrace grain a month, entered in the store book as seal feed, and the steward Bào Thiết Thủ has begun to wonder why the seals are so fat.

doan_to_ba.wants: To dive under the ice shelf where no one has gone, and to make the sixth boat the only crew on the coast that is not for sale.
doan_to_ba.secret: She has taken Kim Hải Yến into the dark-of-the-moon dives, against the old rule that the sixth boat's divers be terrace-born, and tells her father the crew is as it was.
doan_to_ba.add: She tells the council the sixth boat's divers are all terrace-born, though she has taken in a Sóc Phương refugee against the old rule.

ngac_hai_tieu.wants: A name on the coast above Đoàn Thanh Lãng's, and the head's seat before the calf is grown.
ngac_hai_tieu.secret: He has promised each captain a new hull from the calf's second half and is counting votes for the next council, where he means to put the head ashore for the cut line of 1080.

lo_chau_nuong.app: One seed pearl in her left ear, the only one she has never sold.

sub: He mends every boat on the terrace
A boatyard hand's son, he mends the boats he likes first and leaves the rest to leak
bao_thiet_thu.app: Tar-black fingernails and a forearm scarred by a hundred splinters.

nghe_tieu_lang.add: At the ice edge he lets wounded seals die slowly, to teach the boat-boys not to flinch.
nghe_tieu_lang.app: Two toes lost to frostbite, which he shows to new crew.

tan_bach_au.add: She once stood with the rope coiled while a Thôn Hải-born deckhand went under in the inlet, and says the sea took him.
tan_bach_au.app: A fresh gull feather in her braid each week.

dong_vong.app: Net-twine calluses and a yawn that never quite finishes.

quan_tieu_kinh.app: Pale hands that keep out of the spray.

vu_bich_trieu.app: Freckles across her nose like seal whiskers.

boc_kinh_thang.add: He swore his boat to the head, and took Ngạc's iron before the council could meet.
boc_kinh_thang.app: A plank-warped limp and a voice that carries over a gale.

dau_thuy_lang.app: Seal-fur gloves she wears even in summer.

boc_hai_dong.add: He bails only when his father is watching.
boc_hai_dong.app: A notched ear where the winter dive caught him.

kim_hai_yen.add: She skims a cup from every jar of oil she renders for the Pavilion tax.
kim_hai_yen.app: The smell of rendered oil follows her through every door.

lam_nhan_thanh.add: He chants the palm's verses a season behind the others.
lam_nhan_thanh.app: Reed-thin, with duck down in his hair from the ruin.

co_lang_hoa.add: Before a throw-off she frayed Nghê Tiểu Lãng's line a hair.
co_lang_hoa.app: A throwing arm thicker than the other, and a hair-tie of whale gut.

dong_thoa.app: A splicing callus on her thumb as big as a coin.
